text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As Inari One is walking in front of the station with her friend…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oh-ho? Looks like they're hostin' a rakugo comedy event. Looks interestin'.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Look, Inari. The signboard says they'll teach us how to use a folding fan and hand towel. What do you think that means?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Well, in the world of rakugo comedy, they use foldin' fans and hand towels to express a buncha different things.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Like, they might pretend the foldin' fan is a set of chopsticks, a brush, or even a sword. And the hand towel can stand in as a letter, a pouch, or a wallet.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Chopsticks? A letter? Feels like the mystery just keeps getting deeper.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I guess it's pretty meaningless to try and explain it. Somethin' like this is better seen with your own eyes.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: All right, let's take a quick peek. Seein' is way better than hearin' me ramble on about it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While her intentions were to only take a peek, Inari One enjoys the show so much that she loses all track of time and ends up skipping training.
